script:
set -eu
unset LC_ALL
export LC_CTYPE=UTF-8

case "$selection" in
  *[![:space:]]*) ;;
  *)
    printf '%s\n' 'Query is empty' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

restore_clipboard() {
  printf '%s' "$clipboard" | /usr/bin/pbcopy
}
trap restore_clipboard 0

printf '%s' "$selection" | /usr/bin/pbcopy
/usr/bin/open "spotlight://apps"

/usr/bin/osascript <<'APPLESCRIPT'
delay 0.5
tell application "/System/Library/CoreServices/System Events.app"
    keystroke "v" using command down
end tell
delay 0.2
APPLESCRIPT

en.name: Search with Spotlight
en.description: Open Spotlight and search for the selected text.

zh-CN.name: 使用 Spotlight 搜索
zh-CN.description: 打开 Spotlight 并搜索选中文本
